title: 第63章 百草谷第64章 秦川的价值
lines: 柴扉最新章节_第63章 百草谷第1页_柴扉邓子夏_热点小说网
> 第63章 百草谷（第1页）
百草谷的入口，隐藏在一片普通的竹林里。
秦川原以为医道圣地的入口会是一座宏伟的山门——至少应该有汉白玉台阶、蟠龙石柱、刻着“百草谷”三个大字的巨型石碑。但苏木槿带他走进的，只是一条竹林深处的小径。小径尽头是一面爬满青苔的石壁，石壁上有一道仅容一人侧身通过的裂隙。她将手按在石壁上，说了一句秦川听不懂的口令，石壁上的青苔泛出淡淡的绿光，裂隙缓缓扩大，形成了一扇门的形状。
百草谷不是一条山谷——是一座建在群山环绕中的世外桃源。四面都是高耸入云的峭壁，谷底是一片开阔的盆地，盆地上分布着层层叠叠的药田、竹舍和溪流。药田里的草药秦川大半不认识，但有几味他认出来了——龙血藤、鬼面菇、七星草，都是在青山村李神医的药柜上见过的珍稀药材，在这里成片地种植着。
空气中的灵气浓度明显比外界高出不少，但不像是天然的——秦川注意到药田之间分布着许多小型法阵，将天脉的灵气引导到特定的药圃上。这是精准灌溉，不是粗暴地撒肥料。百草谷对灵气的利用方式，比外面那些只靠山门大阵聚拢灵气的宗门精细得多。
苏木槿领着秦川走在谷中主道上，沿途遇到的弟子见到她都会停下来行礼，称一声“苏师姐”或“圣女”。秦川注意到弟子们的目光在落在他身上时，会有短暂的好奇——圣女带一个凡人回谷，这种事应该不常见。
“谷主在药庐等你。”苏木槿说，“我先带你去住的地方。”
百草谷的客舍是一排依山而建的竹楼，每座竹楼只有一层，两三间房，门口带一个小院子。苏木槿给秦川安排的是最靠东头的一间——离药田最近，也最安静。
“你先休息。我去禀报谷主。”苏木槿将秦川送到竹楼门口，转身要走。
“你的师兄弟们看我的眼神，有点不对。”秦川说，“不是敌意——是困惑。困惑我为什么有资格被你亲自带进谷。你最好提前准备一个说法。”
苏木槿沉默了一瞬，轻轻点头。“我会的。”她走出两步，忽然停了一下，侧过头轻声补了一句，“秦公子，谷主是好人。但好人和好说话之间，差着一整个百草谷。”

秦川目送她的背影消失在药田小径的尽头。苏木槿的这句提醒值得反复咀嚼——谷主薛忘忧可能个人对他没有恶意，但作为一谷之主，他需要考虑整个百草谷的利益。如果秦川对百草谷没有价值，或者带来的风险大于价值，薛忘忧的好意随时可能收回。这和青山村不同——老陆他们可以凭个人意愿决定保护他，因为青山村本质上只是一座监狱，不涉及宗门的利益权衡。但百草谷是一个有数千弟子、万亩药田、在中界万族林立的格局中靠中立地位存活的宗门。在这样的地方，薛忘忧的每一个决定都要对全谷上下负责。
秦川走进竹楼，把包袱放在竹床上，没有急着收拾。他走到窗口，看着外面整齐的药田和忙碌的弟子们，开始在脑子里画出百草谷的第一张势力草图。他的信息差理论需要更新了。在青山村，信息差来自观察和推理。在中界，信息差还需要一个信息来源——情报。他需要一个在中界也能获取信息的情报网络，而百草谷是第一块拼图。
窗外，夕阳将药田染成金色，谷中某处传来悠长的钟声。那是暮钟，意味着一天的劳作结束了。秦川靠在窗框上，看着谷中三三两两走回宿舍的年轻弟子们，忽然想起青山村的暮色。这个时辰，老陆应该在劈最后一次柴，王屠户在收案板，赵伯在井边打最后一桶水，李神医在医馆门口喝茶。而他在千里之外的百草谷，站在一扇陌生的窗前，等待明天与谷主的会面。
他摸了摸怀里那块磨刀石。粗砺的表面硌着指腹，很熟悉，很踏实。
然后他关上窗，开始整理从临渊镇到百草谷一路上收集到的所有信息。

> Chapter 63 Baicao Valley (Page 1)
The entrance to Baicao Valley is hidden in an ordinary bamboo forest.
Qinchuan originally thought that the entrance to the Holy Land of Medicine would be a magnificent mountain gate - at least there should be white marble steps, a dragon stone pillar, and a giant stone tablet with the three characters "Baicao Valley" engraved on it. But what Su Mujin took him into was just a path deep in the bamboo forest. At the end of the path was a moss-covered stone wall with a crack that could only allow one person to pass sideways. She pressed her hand on the stone wall and said a command that Qin Chuan could not understand. The moss on the stone wall glowed with a faint green light, and the crack slowly expanded, forming the shape of a door.
Baicao Valley is not a valley - it is a paradise built among mountains. It is surrounded by towering cliffs on all sides, and at the bottom of the valley is an open basin with layers of medicinal fields, bamboo houses and streams. Qin Chuan didn't recognize most of the herbs in the medicine field, but he recognized a few - dragon's blood vine, ghost-faced mushroom, and seven-star grass. They were all rare medicinal materials that he had seen on the medicine cabinet of Divine Doctor Li in Qingshan Village, and they were planted in patches here.
The concentration of spiritual energy in the air was obviously much higher than that of the outside world, but it didn't look like it was natural - Qinchuan noticed that there were many small magic circles distributed among the medicinal fields, guiding the spiritual energy of the heavenly veins to specific medicinal gardens. This is precision irrigation, not a rough spread of fertilizer. Baicao Valley's use of spiritual energy is much more sophisticated than those outside sects that only rely on the mountain gate formation to gather spiritual energy.
Su Mujin led Qin Chuan on the main road in the valley. The disciples he met along the way would stop and salute when they saw her, calling her "Senior Sister Su" or "Saint Girl". Qin Chuan noticed that when the disciples' eyes fell on him, they would be briefly curious - it should be unusual for a saint to bring a mortal back to the valley.
"The Valley Master is waiting for you at Yaolu." Su Muxin said, "I'll take you to where you live first."
The guest houses in Baicao Valley are a row of bamboo buildings built against the mountain. Each bamboo building has only one floor, two or three rooms, and a small courtyard at the door. Su Mujin arranged for Qin Chuan the room at the east end - closest to the medicine field and the quietest.
"You rest first. I'll report to the Valley Master." Su Muxin sent Qin Chuan to the door of the bamboo house and turned to leave.
"There's something wrong with the way your brothers look at me." Qin Chuan said, "It's not hostility - it's confusion. Confused about why I am qualified to be brought into the valley by you personally. You'd better prepare an explanation in advance."
Su Mujin was silent for a moment and nodded slightly. "I will." She took two steps, suddenly paused, turned her head and added softly, "Mr. Qin, the owner of the valley is a good person. But there is a whole Baicao Valley gap between a good person and a good talker."
Qin Chuan watched her disappear at the end of the medicine field path. Su Mujin's reminder is worth chewing over and over again - Valley owner Xue Wangyou may not have any ill intentions towards him personally, but as the owner of a valley, he needs to consider the interests of the entire Baicao Valley. If Qinchuan has no value to Baicao Valley, or the risks it brings are greater than the value, Xue Wangyou's kindness may be withdrawn at any time. This is different from Qingshan Village - Lao Lu and the others can decide to protect him based on their personal wishes, because Qingshan Village is essentially just a prison and does not involve weighing the interests of the sect. But Baicao Valley is a sect with thousands of disciples, thousands of acres of medicinal fields, and a sect that relies on its neutral status to survive in the middle realm where there are thousands of races. In a place like this, every decision Xue Wangyou makes is responsible for the whole valley.
Qin Chuan walked into the bamboo house and put the baggage on the bamboo bed without rushing to pack it away. He walked to the window, looked at the neat medicinal fields and busy disciples outside, and began to draw the first power sketch of Baicao Valley in his mind. His information gap theory needs updating. In Qingshan Village, the information gap comes from observation and reasoning. In the middle world, the information gap also requires a source of information—intelligence. He needs an intelligence network that can also obtain information in the middle world, and Baicao Valley is the first piece of the puzzle.
Outside the window, the setting sun dyed the medicinal fields golden, and a long bell sounded from somewhere in the valley. It was the evening bell, which meant the day's work was over. Qin Chuan leaned against the window frame, watching the young disciples in the valley walking back to their dormitories in twos and threes, and suddenly thought of the dusk in Qingshan Village. At this moment, Lao Lu should be chopping firewood for the last time, Butcher Wang was collecting chopping boards, Uncle Zhao was fetching the last bucket of water from the well, and Doctor Li was drinking tea at the door of the medical center. And he was thousands of miles away in Baicao Valley, standing in front of an unfamiliar window, waiting for his meeting with the owner of the valley tomorrow.
He touched the whetstone in his arms. The rough surface rubs against the fingertips, feeling familiar and at ease.
Then he closed the window and began to sort out all the information collected along the way from Linyuan Town to Baicao Valley.
